name: Deadly Demise 1
summary: Deadly Demise X: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 6, units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds (here 1).

name: Deadly Demise D3
summary: Deadly Demise X: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 6, units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds (here D3).

name: Deadly Demise D6
summary: Deadly Demise X: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 6, units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds (here D6).

name: Deep Strike
summary: Deep Strike: if every model in this unit has this ability, it can arrive via ingress move anywhere more than 8" from all enemy units, even in the opponent's deployment zone.

name: Feel No Pain 5+
summary: Feel No Pain X+: each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6; on an X+ (here 5+), that wound is not lost.

name: Feel No Pain 6+
summary: Feel No Pain X+: each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6; on an X+ (here 6+), that wound is not lost.

name: Fights First
summary: While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit fights first, resolving its attacks before other units in the Fight phase.

name: Firing Deck 2
summary: Firing Deck X: in your Shooting phase, when this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, up to X (here 2) embarked models each lend it one of their ranged weapons (not one-shot) for its attacks; those models' units cannot shoot again this phase.

name: Firing Deck 6
summary: Firing Deck X: in your Shooting phase, when this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, up to X (here 6) embarked models each lend it one of their ranged weapons (not one-shot) for its attacks; those models' units cannot shoot again this phase.

name: Infiltrators
summary: Infiltrators: during deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere more than 8" from the opponent's deployment zone and all enemy units.

name: Leader
summary: Before the battle, you can attach one friendly Leader (and one Support) unit to a bodyguard unit it can lead, forming an attached unit for the battle.

name: Lone Operative
summary: Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemies beyond 12" and cannot be targeted by Indirect Fire weapons from beyond 12" (or the ability's stated distance).

name: Scouts 6"
summary: Scouts X: before the battle, a unit wholly with this ability can set up anywhere in your deployment zone from reserves, or make a scout move of up to X" (here 6") ending more than 8" from all enemy units.

name: Support
summary: Before the battle, you can attach one friendly Support (and one Leader) unit to a bodyguard unit it can lead, forming an attached unit for the battle.

name: Abbess Sanctorum
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit can re-roll Hit rolls and re-roll Wound rolls when they attack.

name: Anchorite Sarcophagus
summary: Gives the bearer a Move characteristic of 7" and a Save characteristic of 3+.

name: Angelic Ascent
summary: After this unit shoots, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy, it can make a further 6" Normal move, but becomes ineligible to charge that turn.

name: Anguish of the Unredeemed
summary: When a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought this phase, roll a D6: on 2+ it fights before being removed as a casualty.

name: ATTACHED UNIT
summary: Lets a Leader character that could normally attach to a different named unit attach to this unit instead.

name: Auto-Tapestry of the Emperor’s Judgement
summary: While this model leads a unit that includes its named companion model, weapons carried by that unit gain the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Censer of the Sacred Rose (Aura)
summary: Friendly units of the bearer's faction within 6" of this model can re-roll failed Battle-shock tests.

name: Cherub
summary: Once per battle, after this unit performs an Act of Faith, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

name: Cherubs
summary: Twice per battle, after this unit performs an Act of Faith, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

name: Consecrated Ground
summary: Friendly infantry of the bearer's faction can move onto this fortification's floor sections, and a friendly unit within 1" of it may perform one extra Act of Faith per phase.

name: Daemonbreaker
summary: When this model attacks a Daemon unit, it can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Death Cult
summary: When a model in this unit attacks a Character unit, it re-rolls one Wound roll.

name: Defenders of the Faith
summary: If this unit ends your Command phase within range of an objective you control, you keep control of it, even with no models present, until an opponent controls it at a turn's start or end.

name: Denuncia Oratory
summary: Whenever this unit's marked quarry is destroyed, you may select a new enemy unit as its quarry.

name: Devastating Refrain
summary: After this model shoots, if an Indirect Fire attack hit an enemy unit, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, and enemy Deadly Demise triggers on a 5+ instead of a 6 against this model's attacks that turn.

name: Divine Deliverance
summary: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can add 3 Attacks to its melee weapons and give them Devastating Wounds until the end of the phase.

name: Embodied Prophecy
summary: When this unit fights, choose Sustained Hits 1 or Lethal Hits for its melee weapons until the end of the phase; if it charged this turn, both apply instead.

name: Emergency Combat Embarkation
summary: Once per turn, in the enemy Charge phase after targets are chosen but before the charge move, a targeted unit not in Engagement Range and within 3" of this transport may embark in it instead.

name: Endless Suffering
summary: This unit remains eligible to declare a charge even in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Executioner of Heretics (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, that unit's Leadership characteristic is worsened by 1.

name: Extremis Trigger Word
summary: When this unit fights, you may invoke its trigger word so that its melee weapons gain an Attacks characteristic of 6 and the Hazardous ability until the end of the phase.

name: Fiery Conviction
summary: If this model is alive at the start of your Command phase, you may either discard a Miracle dice to gain 1CP, or pass a Leadership test on this model to gain 1CP.

name: Fortification
summary: While an enemy unit is only within Engagement Range of friendly Fortifications, non-Pistol attacks against it suffer -1 to Hit, and its models are exempt from Desperate Escape tests unless they'd move over enemy models.

name: Fury of the Righteous
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons carried by that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Healing Tears
summary: While this unit includes its named hero model, in your Command phase, if under Starting Strength, return one destroyed bodyguard model (or up to D3 others) to the unit.

name: Holy Cover
summary: A model hit by a ranged attack while not fully visible to the attacker because of this fortification gains the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

name: Holy Judgement
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, target an enemy unit within 12" and visible to this unit's named hero model; it must take a Battle-shock test (a further -2 if a Chaos unit) or suffer 3 mortal wounds.

name: Holy Mission
summary: If this model is attached to one named squad it gains the Scouts 6" ability; if attached to another named squad it gains the Infiltrators ability instead.

name: Holy Vanguard
summary: If this unit starts the battle embarked and has a Leader attached during Declare Battle Formations, that Leader gains the Scouts 6" ability.

name: Icon of the Valorous Heart (Aura)
summary: While a friendly unit of the bearer's faction is within 6" of this model, models in that unit gain the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

name: Impetuous Fervour
summary: When a model in this unit attacks, it re-rolls a Hit roll of 1, or may re-roll any Hit roll if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Instrument of the Emperor’s Wrath
summary: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can add 3 Attacks to its melee weapons and give them Devastating Wounds until the end of the phase.

name: Judged for Execution
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, mark an enemy unit within 18" and visible to this model; until your next Command phase, friendly attacks of the bearer's faction against it gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Laud Hailer
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, remove Battle-shocked status from one friendly unit of the bearer's faction within 12" of this model.

name: Lifewards
summary: While this unit includes one or more of its named companion models, its named hero model gains the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Litany of Deeds
summary: When you gain a Miracle dice from the destruction of a friendly unit within 12" of this model, you may re-roll that dice's result before adding it to your pool.

name: Medicus Ministorum
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

name: Ministorum Sermon
summary: While this unit contains a MINISTORUM PRIEST, its models' melee weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Miraculous Intervention
summary: The first time this unit's named hero model is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of the phase; on 2+, return it to the battlefield near where it fell, out of Engagement Range, at full wounds.

name: Mysterious Saviours
summary: You can target this unit with Heroic Intervention for -1 CP, regardless of other uses of that stratagem this phase; it does not prevent other units from also using it.

name: Null Rod
summary: Models in the bearer's unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and psychic attacks.

name: One Shot
summary: The bearer may fire this weapon only once per battle.

name: Overseer of Redemption
summary: While this unit includes its named sergeant model, other models in the unit re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls when they make melee attacks.

name: Petals of the Bloody Rose (Aura)
summary: While a friendly unit of the bearer's faction is within 6" of this model, melee weapons carried by that unit gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Purge and Cleanse
summary: After this model shoots, select an enemy unit it hit; that unit cannot claim the Benefit of Cover until the end of the phase.

name: Rapturous Blows
summary: When this model's unit fights, you may discard a Miracle dice so that, until the end of the phase, each of its successful melee Wound rolls also inflicts 1 mortal wound.

name: Recount the Deeds of the Saints
summary: While this model leads a unit containing its named companion, each enemy unit that unit destroys grants 1 Miracle dice, and D3 more when the companion model is destroyed.

name: Relics of the Matriarchs
summary: At the start of the battle round, choose up to two listed relic abilities; this model has those abilities until the start of the next battle round.

name: Righteous Awareness
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit and it is not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Righteous Denunciation
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

name: Righteous Paragons
summary: When a model in this unit attacks a Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Righteous Repugnance
summary: When this model's unit shoots or fights, you may discard a Miracle dice to add 3 Attacks to its named weapons until the end of the phase; each enemy unit this model destroys grants 1 Miracle dice.

name: Righteous Smiting
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee attacks made by models in that unit add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Rites of Castigation
summary: After this model shoots, select an enemy unit it hit; until the end of the turn, friendly ranged attacks of the bearer's faction against it gain +1 Armour Penetration. Each enemy unit can be selected only once per turn.

name: Rituale Nullificatus
summary: Models in this unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Rod of Office
summary: When a model in the bearer's unit attacks, it re-rolls a Hit roll of 1.

name: Sacred Banner
summary: Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit can be re-rolled.

name: Sacred Command
summary: Once per battle round, when a unit with this ability is targeted by a Stratagem, its CP cost is reduced by 1.

name: Sacred Healing
summary: While this model leads a unit, in your Command phase you may return 1 destroyed non-Character model to it, or discard a Miracle dice to return up to D3+1 instead.

name: Salvationist Medikit
summary: In your Command phase, if the bearer is alive, return up to D3 destroyed non-Character models to this unit.

name: Self Repair
summary: At the start of your Command phase, this model regains 1 lost wound.

name: Simulacrum Imperialis
summary: Usually: at the end of your Command phase, roll a D6 for each objective marker you control with a bearing unit in range, gaining a Miracle dice of that value on a 4+. One bearer instead improves its unit's Leadership by 1.

name: Simulacrum of the Argent Shroud (Aura)
summary: While a friendly unit of the bearer's faction is within 6" of this model, its models re-roll a Wound roll of 1 on ranged attacks.

name: Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice (Aura)
summary: While a friendly unit of the bearer's faction is within 6" of this model, it can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase instead of one.

name: Solemn Procession
summary: While this model is alive, each Miracle dice gained at the start of the battle round has a value of 6 instead of being rolled.

name: Spiritual Fortitude
summary: Models in this unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Stanchion of Holy Martyrs
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit gain a Save characteristic of 2+ and a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Stirring Rhetoric
summary: While this model leads a unit, each time that unit performs an Act of Faith, one of the Miracle dice used is treated as a 6.

name: Storm of Retribution
summary: This unit's ranged attacks can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1; against an enemy unit that has destroyed a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit this battle, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll instead.

name: SUPREME COMMANDER
summary: If this unit is included in your army, it must be your Warlord.

name: Sworn Protectors
summary: While a Character of the bearer's faction leads this unit, attacks against this unit subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

name: The Emperor’s Grace
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can gain a 2+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

name: The Fiery Heart (Aura)
summary: While a friendly unit of the bearer's faction is within 6" of this model, add 2" to that unit's Move and add 1 to its Advance and Charge rolls.

name: The Pulpit of Saint Holline's Basilica
summary: This unit has Stealth, and melee attacks that target it take -1 to hit.

name: Unflinching Determination
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

name: Virtue of Intolerance
summary: At the start of the battle, mark an enemy unit as this unit's quarry; attacks against that quarry gain the Precision ability and can re-roll the Hit roll, even while embarked.

name: Zealot
summary: Once per battle, in the Fight phase, this model can improve its melee weapons' Strength and Attacks characteristics by 3 until the end of the phase.

name: Acts of Faith
summary: ADEPTA SORORITAS units gain Miracle dice (1 per battle round, plus 1 whenever an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is destroyed) to substitute for one dice in an Advance, Charge, Battle-shock, Hit, Wound, Save, or Damage roll.
